trialBalance.title: Trial balance
trialBalance.unbalancedBody: The books are out of balance for this period. Do not close it; report the trace id to the finance owner.

manual.title: Manual journals
manual.lead: Manual journals are proposed by one user and posted only after a second user approves them (four-eyes).
manual.emptyBody: Propose a journal when an adjustment cannot come from a business event.
manual.notFound: The manual journal does not exist.

form.title: New manual journal
form.fourEyesBody: You propose this journal; a different user must approve it before anything is posted. You cannot approve your own journal.
form.evidenceHelp: Reference of the supporting document. Required.
form.unbalanced: Debits and credits must be equal and above zero
form.submitted: The manual journal was submitted for approval.
form.failed: The manual journal could not be submitted

errors.amount: Line {n}: enter an amount above zero.
errors.unbalanced: Debits and credits must be equal.

decision.title: Decision
decision.approved: The manual journal was approved and posted.
decision.withdrawFailed: The journal could not be withdrawn
decision.makerBody: You submitted this journal, so you cannot approve or reject it. Ask a colleague to decide, or withdraw it.

intake.title: Intake exceptions
intake.lead: Business events that could not be posted wait here for a fix. After correcting the cause, run them again.
intake.emptyBody: Every event received so far was posted or intentionally skipped.
intake.rejectBody: A rejected event is never posted. This cannot be undone.

done.rerun: The event was queued to run again.
done.mark-duplicate: The event was marked as a duplicate.

close.title: Period close
close.lead: Every accounting month and its state. A locked month refuses new postings; reopening needs a reason.
close.emptyBody: A period appears with the first posting or when it is locked.
close.reasonHelp: Recorded in the audit trail with your name.
close.failed: The close step was not applied

lock.title: Lock period {period}?
lock.body: Other modules can no longer post into this month. Reopening later needs approval and a reason.

reopen.title: Reopen period {period}?
reopen.body: Postings into this month become possible again and reports for it may change.

earning.title: Earning run
earning.lead: The earning run posts the premium earned up to a date.
earning.warnBody: The run posts journals. Check the period is open and the date is right before you start.
earning.confirmBody: Earned premium up to this date is posted to the books.
earning.started: The earning run as of {date} was started.
earning.failed: The earning run did not start
